scope: Repair the GTK2 Theme Lab native preview so its stretched scrollbar body uses the measured SR10.4 cross-axis relief profile.
cause: R726 corrected the installed GTK2 theme renderer, but the Theme Lab preview has its own gtk2_recipe.py generator. That generator continued to stretch a generic bevel across the long body, producing DDFFFFFFFFFFFLL instead of the shared SR10.4 profile DDLLFFFFFFFDDLL.
changes: tools/theme-lab/gtk2_recipe.py: paint the shared measured profile between the five-pixel caps in horizontal and vertical previews; preserve explicit sunken, raised and flat trough adjustments.
tools/theme-lab/tests/test_gtk2_recipe.py: assert palette-derived body pixels in both orientations and verify raised/flat adjustments.

native_gtk2_capture.horizontal_body_profile: 15/15 pixels equal the generated native GTK2 asset
native_gtk2_capture.vertical_body_profile: 15/15 pixels equal the generated native GTK2 asset

gallery.result: The public native GTK2 gallery reported metrics for all 16 controls, registered native push/toggle/check/radio clicks, emitted 52 events and closed normally in private bwrap/Xvfb.

evidence.stepper_pressure: The separate full scrollbar interaction run stopped at the horizontal-left held-state assertion: its GTK2 capture showed zero changed pixels. This does not invalidate the normal long-body profile capture, but the pressed-arrow comparison remains unverified and must not be reported as passing.

verification.gtk2_recipe_tests: 8 tests passed with temporary files routed to ~/tempia.
verification.native_normal_profile: Passed: native GTK2 horizontal and vertical body cross-sections each match the generated image at 15/15 pixels.
verification.native_gallery: Passed for the GTK2 gallery lifecycle and all 16 control metrics; it does not establish pressed-arrow fidelity.
verification.visual_acceptance: Pending user review; technical pixel checks are not human visual approval.

result: The Theme Lab GTK2 preview now paints the same measured normal body profile as the shared SR10.4 rule, using the current KDE semantic palette. This closes the separate preview-generator gap that remained after R726; it does not certify every GTK2 state or the full family.
next: Keep the active family GTK2. The user can regenerate/reload the GTK2 preview and assess the normal relief. Keep the horizontal-left pressed-state discrepancy and human visual review open. Preserve the current user palette and do not change other toolkits in this step.

coverage_estimate.basis: I167 technical coverage estimate; visual acceptance and the held-arrow discrepancy remain open. This is not a fidelity percentage.
